title: A workspace with perspective
description: Dimensional product scene → real page navigation → retained journey context

scenes.headline: An idea or a codebase. Both are a beginning.
scenes.body: Choose Start New or Evolve from Home. The original dimensional brief, source and story scene introduces the kind of context each journey keeps.
scenes.receipt: Artwork is illustrative, not a running agent, customer result or completed application.

scenes.headline: Move through the product, not a stack of disconnected screens.
scenes.body: Use the three scene viewpoint controls, then visit About or What We Do. Native Back and Forward, linked breadcrumbs and the Home logo keep navigation predictable. Reduced motion and unavailable WebGL show a labelled visual alternative.
scenes.receipt: The 3D scene uses original geometry. It illustrates intent, source and story; it never reports completed engineering work.

scenes.headline: Keep the actual work separate from the illustration.
scenes.body: Open a journey, edit its brief and contextual storyboard, and visit another page. Return to the same in-memory context. Brief, Local run and Demo Studio use real query-string URLs; real local task details still come from persisted events.
scenes.receipt: Hosted exports remain unverified drafts. Local source analysis neither executes imported code nor proves application correctness.

title: Start New
description: Product intent → local starter → contextual draft story

scenes.headline: Make the brief useful before writing code.
scenes.body: Describe who uses the onboarding portal, which documents they submit, and how a reviewer knows the request is complete. Export the planning brief.
scenes.receipt: User-authored JSON brief. No hosted agent execution or custom feature generation.

scenes.headline: A starter is a beginning, not a finished product.
scenes.body: On your self-hosted /studio/ origin, explicitly sign in to the local engine, choose a template and create a runnable starter. Request static analysis and inspect recorded worker events.
scenes.receipt: Separate cookie/CSRF session. The template does not implement the customer's whole brief or run its acceptance tests.

scenes.headline: Keep the story beside the work.
scenes.body: Open Demo Studio inside Start New. Edit a scene, switch workflow tabs or journeys, and return to the same draft. Export the storyboard with its brief and project context.
scenes.receipt: Edits last in the open workspace only. Storyboard JSON is unverified, not a rendered video or proof of a working portal.

title: Evolve
description: Authorized snapshot → source findings → honest change narrative

scenes.headline: Start with the change you want to understand.
scenes.body: Describe a billing service's current behavior, desired improvement and regressions to avoid. On the local studio, import an authorized ZIP snapshot for analysis.
scenes.receipt: Hosted Evolve exports a brief only. Local ZIP import reads source without executing it or requesting repository credentials.

scenes.headline: Review findings, not a claim of correctness.
scenes.body: Watch the local job move through its real recorded states. Expand the event timeline and review the latest project analysis, including skipped files and finding confidence.
scenes.receipt: Static heuristics are not a security audit. No code changes or application tests are performed by analysis.

scenes.headline: Tell the Evolve story, not a different journey.
scenes.body: Open Demo Studio from this Evolve brief. Edit the customer action and limitation, then export the matching Evolve story without losing edits when switching journeys.
scenes.receipt: A contextual unverified storyboard, not a verified patch or automatically generated PR. Rendering requires the separate Remotion pipeline.

title: Recorded local work
description: Explicit local sign-in → real worker lifecycle → compact outcome

scenes.headline: Know which engine you are using.
scenes.body: Open /studio/ on the self-hosted API, explicitly sign in with its supported local identity, and request analysis from Start New or Evolve. The API persists the queued job.
scenes.receipt: Local cookies and CSRF stay same-origin. Supabase login does not grant engine access; hosted SPA HTML is not accepted as an API.

scenes.headline: A visible task list grounded in recorded state.
scenes.body: A running worker updates the job. The studio shows elapsed time, the analysis operation and lifecycle tasks. Expand timestamps and recorded events, or cancel the job.
scenes.receipt: No invented subtools, percentages, ETA or private reasoning. Cancel fences result delivery; computation may continue until worker return.

scenes.headline: One elapsed label. An honest result.
scenes.body: On success, read a compact completion state and expand its timeline if needed. Failures and cancellations stay explicit; a lost connection preserves the last known state without claiming success.
scenes.receipt: The latest project findings are labeled separately from older selected runs. Source analysis does not verify application behavior.

scenes.headline: Capture the complete outcome.
scenes.body: A useful experiment records failures, runtime costs and acceptance criteria as well as wins.
scenes.receipt: Offline evidence records exist, not autonomous learning.

scenes.headline: Compare on equal footing.
scenes.body: Run baseline and candidate over matched tasks; reject safety failures, regressions and cost overruns.
scenes.receipt: Implemented in the Python evidence gate.

scenes.headline: Only reviewed improvements ship.
scenes.body: A favorable result creates a recommendation for human review, never an automatic production change.
scenes.receipt: Fail-closed human approval is enforced by current evaluation gate.

title: Private chats
description: Private message → consent-based invite → controlled collaboration

scenes.headline: Your conversations belong to you.
scenes.body: Only the authenticated creator can read a new conversation. Workspace membership alone never unlocks it.
scenes.receipt: PostgreSQL row policies tested against simulated authenticated users; real login remains pending.

scenes.headline: Invite the right person—not the whole team.
scenes.body: Address a verified Outlook/work email or existing @alias. A pending invitation reveals no content until it is accepted.
scenes.receipt: Synthetic multi-account test verified pending isolation and explicit acceptance; in-app invitations only.

scenes.headline: Viewer, editor, revoke.
scenes.body: Choose read-only or contribution access. Revoke a share to remove access without exposing messages by public link.
scenes.receipt: Database verification passed for viewer/editor separation and owner revocation; real browser accounts untested.

title: Evolve repository intelligence
description: Reviewable repository inventory → scoped static findings → content-addressed evidence

scenes.headline: Know what is inside before you change it.
scenes.body: On the self-hosted Evolve journey, import a public GitHub repository or an authorized ZIP under a strict size and path policy. Unsupported hosted imports remain visibly unavailable.
scenes.receipt: Static repository parsing only. ZIP validation and rollback are covered by regression tests; the Vercel frontend has no hosted importer.

scenes.headline: Identify the stack, with the limits in sight.
scenes.body: Inspect manifest-derived framework/package-manager hints, source language counts, test and CI presence, and confidence-labelled heuristic findings. Python security checks examine AST calls instead of guessing from comments.
scenes.receipt: Framework hints derive from non-executed manifests. Analysis is bounded and never proves a dependency is installed or a vulnerability exploitable.

scenes.headline: Trace what changed, without inventing a fix.
scenes.body: A complete bounded source fingerprint and explicit findings-truncation flag tell reviewers whether an analysis is stale or partial. Read-only patches still require human approval and independent tests.
scenes.receipt: The source hash is scoped to analyzed files and supported readable manifests. No deployed agent, behavioral proof, automatic PR or real customer gain is claimed.
